notes:
E-Sys MAX 5.3.1

New
- Updates: a download that stops goes on from where it stopped, also after you close E-Sys MAX. If the line drops, E-Sys MAX tries again by itself.
- Updates: a progress bar shows how far the download is ("42 %, 31 of 73 MB"), and Cancel stops it without losing what already came in.
- Updates: when an antivirus program removes the downloaded installer, E-Sys MAX says so plainly and shows how to download by hand.
- NCD editor: settings that change emissions are never written, and safety settings ask for a Yes first, the same as in E-Sys.
- E-Sys MAX Demo on a PC with a bought licence turns into the full E-Sys MAX by itself once the licence is confirmed.

Improved
- Home: car names in your garage show whole (on two lines when needed), with the full name when you point at them.
- Home: buttons, versions and cars light up softly when you point at them, and every panel has the same spacing.
- Home: the "Last session" line is never cut at the bottom, and its minutes are in your language.
- Russian, Spanish and Italian: buttons and badge names that were cut now show whole.
- Connection check: the firewall fix only adds a rule for a Java that only administrators can change.
- Practice car: Fake Car 1.7.1 builds practice cars on Windows in any language (on a Turkish Windows it stopped with an error).
- Smoother: starting E-Sys and the check after a download no longer pause the window.
- Problem reports now include the update steps, so support can see why an update did not finish.
- Many small fixes.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
